first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: The paved Gray Racetrack in the lower part of the main view, curving left ahead.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: The long silver-gray Metal Guardrails on both sides of the racetrack, with multiple horizontal beams and spaced connecting structures visible.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: The narrow strip of alternating red and white blocks along the edge of the racetrack.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The Blue Sky background in the upper part of the main view, partially covered by the on-screen interface.

entities.name: Lake Surface
entities.identification: The blue-gray Lake Surface extending horizontally behind the guardrail and the Yellow-and-Black Arrow Barrier Wall.

entities.name: Distant Mountain
entities.identification: The low-contrast, undulating blue-purple mountain ridge behind the green shoreline on the opposite side of the lake.

entities.name: Yellow-and-Black Arrow Barrier Wall
entities.identification: The continuous black band-shaped barrier wall along the outer edge of the left turn, with repeated yellow left-pointing arrows.

entities.name: White Billboard with Circular Logo
entities.identification: The white rectangular billboard on the outside of the turn, with a dark blue oval ring and red Esso lettering.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The orange text, top rearview panel, lower-left route map, lower-right circular gauge, and green indicators on the right side of the screen.

entities.name: Yellow Directional Road Sign
entities.identification: The vertical yellow rectangular road sign outside the lakeside guardrail, with a thick black left-turn arrow on its face.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The steep slope on the left side of the racetrack that rises above the road surface, and the lower raised terrain behind the billboard; excludes the vegetation covering them.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The dark and light green vegetation areas on the left slope, inside the curb, and on the opposite side of the lake.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low, horizontally wide image of a yellow race car in the top rearview panel, moving from the right part of the panel to the left part during the latter portion.
